base_asset.description: Base asset the config applies to, across its dated options and perpetual futures

delta_limit.description: Delta limit in base asset units; 0 = check disabled

frozen_time_ms.description: How long a trip freezes MMP orders, in milliseconds. 0 freezes until a manual reset

interval_ms.description: Sliding window length in milliseconds. 0 when MMP was removed

protect_block_trades.description: Whether block trade legs, RFQ executions included, are protected

removed.description: True when MMP was removed for this base asset; the limits above are then zero

size_limit.description: Size limit in base asset units; 0 = check disabled

updated_at.description: Unix milliseconds the config was last written

vega_limit.description: Vega limit in USD; 0 = check disabled

ChannelsMmpSubscribeKind.description: TRIGGERED: a limit tripped. UNFROZEN: the freeze expired. RESET: MMP was reset. CONFIG_UPDATED: the config changed
ChannelsMmpSubscribeKind.title: ChannelsMmpSubscribeKind

base_asset.description: Base asset the event applies to

frozen_until.description: Unix milliseconds the freeze ends on TRIGGERED, where 0 means until a manual reset. Always 0 on other kinds, which says nothing about freeze state

kind.description: TRIGGERED: a limit tripped. UNFROZEN: the freeze expired. RESET: MMP was reset. CONFIG_UPDATED: the config changed

trigger_market.description: Market of the fill that tripped, TRIGGERED only

window_delta.description: Signed sum of fill delta in the window when the limit tripped, TRIGGERED only

window_size.description: Sum of fill size in the window when the limit tripped, TRIGGERED only

window_vega.description: Signed sum of fill vega in USD in the window when the limit tripped, TRIGGERED only
